profile.subtitleJa: 年ごとの礼拝と祭儀が行われた町・聖所
profile.summaryJa: サムエル記上1:3では、エルカナが年ごとにシロへ上り、主に礼拝し犠牲をささげます。祭司エリの二人の子もそこにいたと記され、本文は町と聖所を結び付けています。
profile.modernLocationJa: 記事は古代シロを現代のキルベト・セイルン（テル・シロ）と結び付けています。
profile.historicalRoleJa: エルカナが年ごとに礼拝と犠牲をささげに上る町・聖所として初出する。
profile.locationNoteJa: 現代遺跡候補は記事に基づく比定。地域の政治的境界を意味しません。

wikipedia.title: Shiloh (biblical city)
wikipedia.noteJa: 記事は古代の町・聖所を扱い、エリとサムエルが仕えた場所として1サムエル記1–3章に結び付けます。現代のキルベト・セイルンとの同定も紹介します。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: This man went up out of his city from year to year to worship and to sacrifice to the LORD of Armies in Shiloh. The two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, priests to the LORD, were there.
So Hannah rose up after they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh. Now Eli the priest was sitting on his seat by the doorpost of the LORD’s temple.
When she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bulls, and one ephah of meal, and a container of wine, and brought him to the LORD’s house in Shiloh. The child was young.
and he stabbed it into the pan, or kettle, or cauldron, or pot. The priest took all that the fork brought up for himself. They did this to all the Israelites who came there to Shiloh.
The LORD appeared again in Shiloh; for the LORD revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the LORD’s word.

When the people had come into the camp, the elders of Israel said, “Why has the LORD defeated us today before the Philistines? Let’s get the ark of the LORD’s covenant out of Shiloh and bring it to us, that it may come among us and save us out of the hand of our enemies.”

So the people sent to Shiloh, and they brought from there the ark of the covenant of the LORD of Armies, who sits above the cherubim; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.
A man of Benjamin ran out of the army and came to Shiloh the same day, with his clothes torn and with dirt on his head.
including Ahijah the son of Ahitub, Ichabod’s brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli the priest of the LORD in Shiloh, wearing an ephod. The people didn’t know that Jonathan was gone.

review.identityCheckJa: 同じ綴りの創世記49:10の「シロ」は人物または別解釈の可能性があると記事自身が説明する（lines 311–317）。本書の1:3は町・聖所の地名であり、その人物解釈とは区別する。
